story.heading: A firm built for the courtroom
paragraphs: You should know who is handling your case. Our name is on the door because the work is ours.
Bring the facts. We will tell you if we can help, and we will not waste your time if we cannot.
Eisenberg, Rothweiler, Winkler, Eisenberg & Jeck, P.C. serves people who live and work in Philadelphia.
You'll find the phone and the next step on this page, not buried in a menu.
Come in when you're ready. We'll make the visit straightforward.

feature.heading: Counsel you can reach
feature.text: Injury work is personal. We keep the file close and the updates human so you are never guessing what happens next.

spotlight.heading: Center City office
spotlight.text: The Spruce Street office is where we meet clients. Call first so we can make time.

contact.heading: Start with a call
contact.sub: Use the phone on this page. Have the date, the place, and what you have already been told.
